newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Industrivarden says sells unit to Tornet.
newsitem.headline: Industrivarden says sells unit to Tornet.

text.p: Swedish investment company Industrivarden said on Friday it had reached an agreement to sell its property unit Fundament to MalarTornet AB, a subsidiary of Swedish property company Tornet.
Industrivarden will post a capital gain of 200 million crowns on the sale, the company said in a statement without disclosing the sale price.
"The reason for the sale is that Industrivarden wishes to reduce its total investment on the property side," the company said. Industrivarden has owned Fundament since 1981.
Fundament owns 107,000 square metres of property space, mainly in office buildings in the Stockholm area, Industrivarden said.
In April, Fundament's hotel property in Karlstad, Sweden, was sold for a capital gain of 17 million crowns.
